visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a red baseball cap and a black t-shirt with 'GOOPIMADE' branding stands outdoors in front of a bakery named '不二糕餅'. He speaks directly to the camera with high energy, using frequent hand gestures. (2) Close-up shots of a menu display showing drink and pastry pairings titled 'Single serving' and 'Pairing'. (3) The man is back outside, continuing his explanation. (4) Transition to an indoor setting where a clear cup is filled with a red liquid and topped with white cream foam. (5) A dark beverage is poured into a footed glass with a 'Bar Mood' logo. (6) Two men, the main character and another with long hair and glasses, sit at a wooden table inside a brightly lit store. They are seen eating golden-brown egg yolk pastries and sipping drinks. (7) Close-up shots show the flaky texture of the egg yolk pastry and colorful drinks layered in glasses. (8) The camera pans across the store interior, showing shelves of red gift boxes and a signage area for 'BERRY CHILL VERY YOU'. (9) A close-up of a capsule toy machine filled with silver and pink capsules. (10) The main character holds up a red gift box containing stickers and two small shot glasses. (11) He holds a pink box of 'Fuling Kah' snacks. (12) The man points at the camera in a modern urban plaza and walks away.

(2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition to the menu. (3) A subtle digital 'pop' sound occurs as variety text appears on screen. (4) The BGM continues with a consistent drum beat and synthetic bass line. (5) A clear percussive 'crunch' sound is heard as the speaker bites into a pastry, followed by a vocal exclamation of 'super delicious'. (6) A second male voice with a lower pitch enters the conversation, sounding casual and satisfied. (7) Mechanical clicks are audible during a shot of a gashapon machine. (8) The main speaker's voice remains dominant and enthusiastic throughout the outro, with the music swelling slightly in the final seconds before a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Explanation -> Experience -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a limited-time collaboration event ('Berry Chill Very You') between Bu Er Bakery, Bar Mood, and Vender at PARK2 Taichung. It uses an energetic vlog style to showcase specific pastry and drink pairings, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, and highlights on-site activities like capsule toy games and gift boxes to encourage viewers to visit the pop-up location.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly introduces the brand collaboration, reviews the products, and provides details about the event dates and locations.
